breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated factor-of-safety definition; with n = S_y / σ_avg, the working stress should appear in the denominator, not the numerator.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt gave two conflicting definitions for the factor of safety. The generated specification correctly discarded the erroneous definition (n = σ_avg / S_y) and only included the correct one, stating to compute it as 'Sy divided by the average normal stress' (n = Sy / σ_avg). This aligns with the ground truth prompt.
